_comment: The org's one shortcode map (pandoscope/pandoscope#61): shortcode to repository under repos, in the format the thread ledger reads, e.g. "mr": "my-org/my-repo". Every shortcode is lowercase, so an order's name and a reference in a reply use the same spelling: review-spec-fidelity-opus-mr4-1 and mr#4. Seeded once and owned by this waybill: the template ships no org's names and never overwrites the org's entries.
